title: If I Come and Find It
audience: Ethiopian and Habesha viewers, at home and in the diaspora, watching on their phones (TikTok, Instagram, Telegram, family WhatsApp groups).
intent: Viewers recognise their own mom, laugh at the memory, tag their siblings, and end feeling warm about her. In the moment it was not funny (Mom was really angry or busy); the laugh comes when we remember it. This is the tone of the film, shown through Mom's real anger, not said out loud.

style.description: Warm hand-painted 2D illustration, soft film grain, golden afternoon light, cosy Ethiopian home, expressive comic faces, gentle exaggeration like a family cartoon

characters.description: Ethiopian mother in her mid-40s, warm brown skin, kind round face, hair wrapped in a white netela with a thin green, yellow and red tilet border, wearing a simple cream habesha dress at home, small gold cross necklace
Ethiopian girl about 11 years old, curly black hair in two puffs with yellow ribbons, big expressive eyes, blue and white striped t-shirt, grey skirt
The same girl grown up, mid-20s, curly black hair worn loose, yellow ribbon tied on her wrist, casual cream sweater

shots.reason: Hook: names the shared experience in the first seconds so Habesha viewers stop scrolling.
shots.image_prompt: Cosy Ethiopian living room full of relatives on low sofas, coffee ceremony on the floor: a round-bellied black clay coffee pot with a long thin neck, a small spout and a handle, tiny handleless white cups on a wooden tray, fresh green grass spread on the floor, a small incense burner with smoke, a bowl of popcorn, mom sitting in the centre, golden afternoon light
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push-in towards mom, incense smoke drifting, relatives laughing
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.narration: እያንዳንዷ የሀበሻ እናት የተደበቀ ልዕለ ኃይል አላት።
shots.subtitle_en: Every Habesha mom has a hidden superpower.
shots.wan_motion_prompt: Almost still. Steam rises gently from the coffee cups, the family breathe, blink and smile softly. Everyone stays in place. Camera very slowly pushes in

shots.reason: Sets up the request: an ordinary moment every viewer has lived.
shots.image_prompt: Mom on the sofa among guests, pointing towards a hallway, the girl standing beside her ready to go
shots.motion_prompt: Mom gestures towards the hallway, the girl nods and turns to walk
shots.speaker: mom
shots.delivery: Completely normal, casual, still chatting with guests. Not a joke to her
shots.narration: ልጄ፣ ቦርሳዬን ከመኝታ ቤቱ ጠረጴዛ ላይ አምጪልኝ።
shots.subtitle_en: My daughter, bring me my bag from the bedroom table.

shots.reason: The search: exaggerated effort makes the later reveal funnier.
shots.image_prompt: Bedroom turned upside down, the girl on her knees looking under the bed with a worried, panicked face, wardrobe doors open, clothes flying, the bedside table empty
shots.motion_prompt: Fast comic pan across the room as the girl searches frantically, clothes tossed in the air
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.delivery: Building comic tension, a little faster
shots.narration: ገባሁ። ጠረጴዛው ላይ የለም። ከአልጋ ስር፣ ቁም ሳጥን ውስጥ… ሁሉንም ቦታ ፈለግኩ።
shots.subtitle_en: I went in. Not on the table. Under the bed, in the wardrobe... I searched everywhere.
shots.wan_motion_prompt: The girl stays kneeling in the same place and slowly turns her head to look around, a cloth in her hand moves a little. Camera static

shots.reason: The child's surrender: the mistake every kid makes.
shots.image_prompt: The girl standing in the bedroom doorway, hands cupped around her mouth, shouting towards the living room, frustrated face
shots.motion_prompt: The girl shouts, shoulders drop, small camera shake
shots.speaker: child
shots.delivery: Shouting from another room, frustrated, a little scared
shots.subtitle_en: Mom! It's not here! I can't find it!
shots.wan_motion_prompt: The girl stands still with her hands on her cheeks, she blinks and her shoulders drop slightly. Camera static

shots.reason: The moment the child dreads: Mom is really annoyed and coming. The laugh comes from viewers remembering it, not from Mom joking.
shots.image_prompt: Mom in the living room, furious, frowning, eyebrows drawn together, putting her coffee cup down hard and getting up from the sofa, Ethiopian relatives behind her going quiet and staring
shots.motion_prompt: Mom rises from the sofa, annoyed, and walks towards the hallway
shots.speaker: mom
shots.delivery: Angry: she asked for one simple thing and the child says it's not there
shots.narration: ምን?! የለም?! እኔ መጥቼ ካገኘሁት… እረግጥሻለሁ!
shots.subtitle_en: What?! It's not there?! If I come in there and find it... I'm kicking you!
shots.wan_motion_prompt: Mom stays standing in the centre of the frame with an angry face and points one finger towards the hallway; the guests glance at her. Camera static

shots.reason: The reveal: the bag was in plain sight the whole time.
shots.image_prompt: Mom storming into the messy bedroom, annoyed face, the bag sitting in plain sight in the middle of the bed with a soft glow, the girl frozen and scared
shots.motion_prompt: Mom marches in, glances once, camera snaps to the glowing bag on the bed
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.delivery: Disbelief, then a beat of silence before the last words
shots.narration: እናቴ ገባች። አንድ ሰከንድ እንኳን አልፈጀባትም። አልጋው ላይ ነበር፣ ፊት ለፊቴ!
shots.subtitle_en: Mom walked in. It didn't take her one second. It was on the bed, right in front of me!

shots.reason: Mom's scolding line, the second classic phrase. Serious for the child; funny only in hindsight.
shots.image_prompt: Mom furious and scolding, frowning, mouth open mid-shout, holding the brown handbag up high right in front of the girl's face and pointing at it with her other hand; the girl looks down at the floor, embarrassed; messy bedroom behind them
shots.motion_prompt: close push-in on mom's angry face
shots.speaker: mom
shots.delivery: Angry disbelief when she finds it right there: 'what is this?!'
shots.narration: ይኸው! ይሄ ምንድነው?! ዓይንሽ የት ነው ያለው?!
shots.subtitle_en: Here it is! What is this?! Where are your eyes?!

shots.reason: Second story setup: Mom is overloaded and busy, which is why the next answer comes out the way it does.
shots.image_prompt: Ethiopian kitchen, mom stressed and sweating over a big pot of red doro wot, steam and chopped onions everywhere, several pots on the stove, the girl behind her proudly holding a full dustpan of trash
shots.motion_prompt: Steam rising, mom stirring quickly, the girl walks in holding the dustpan
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.delivery: Light, setting up the next joke
shots.narration: ሌላ ቀን ደግሞ እናቴ ወጥ እየሰራች ነበር። ቤቱን አጽድቼ ቆሻሻውን ይዤ መጣሁ።
shots.subtitle_en: Another day, Mom was busy making wot. I cleaned the house and came with the trash.

shots.reason: The innocent question that sets up the final punchline.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the girl holding the dustpan, innocent hopeful face
shots.motion_prompt: The girl tilts her head and asks
shots.speaker: child
shots.subtitle_en: Mom, where should I put the trash?

shots.reason: The biggest laugh for viewers, because every Habesha kid has heard it from a stressed mom.
shots.image_prompt: View from behind the mother: we see her back and white headwrap as she stands at the stove stirring a pot hard; she does not turn around; one hand raised back over her shoulder, waving the girl away in irritation; the girl stands in the kitchen doorway in the background holding the dustpan, confused
shots.speaker: mom
shots.delivery: Sarcastic and angry, busy at the stove, not looking up

shots.reason: Lands the idea: now, together, we laugh. The scolding turns into love, which is what makes people share it.
shots.image_prompt: Years later, the grown-up daughter in her mid-20s (same curly hair, yellow ribbon tied on her wrist) and her older mom laughing together on the sofa over coffee, warm lamp light, the same old bag beside them
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pull-out from mother and daughter laughing together
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.delivery: Warm and affectionate, slowing down at the end
shots.narration: ሀበሻ እናቶች ሁሉንም ነገር ያገኛሉ፤ ለሁሉም ነገር መልስ አላቸው። ለእማዬ።
shots.subtitle_en: Habesha moms find everything, and have an answer for everything. For my mom.

music.prompt: Playful Ethiopian comedy score, krar and masinko melody, light kebero percussion, warm and cheeky, tizita-inspired warmth at the end, instrumental, about 100 bpm
